newsitem.title: FINLAND: Forestry sector boosts Finnish Nov industry output.
newsitem.headline: Forestry sector boosts Finnish Nov industry output.

text.p: Strong growth in forest industry output boosted Finnish industrial production in November, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Wednesday.
Output in the wood and paper industry surged 14.3 percent year-on-year after an increase of 6.8 percent in October.

The pace of growth in paper and pulp production accelerated to 13.5 percent in November from 7.5 percent a month earlier, while mechanical forest industry production increased 16.3 percent, up from 5.4 percent in October.
Forest industry capacity utilisation climbed to over 92 percent in November from 85 percent in November 1995, SF said. @
Overall, Finnish industrial production adjusted for working days rose 7.2 percent year-on-year -- more than a percentage point above five economists' mean forecast at 6.1 percent.
Metal, engineering and electrotechnical production increased 7.1 percent year-on-year, up from 6.4 percent in October.

In this category metals production rose 8.5 percent in November with iron and steel output up 11.1 percent. Growth in production of metal products slowed to 3.6 percent from 6.4 percent and machinery and equipment production slowed to a 9.5 percent rise in November from 11.7 percent in October, SF said.

In electrotechnical production, output rose 10.8 percent year-on-year, up from 6.7 percent a month earlier, and growth in chemical industry production also picked up speed, to 8.9 percent from 5.3 percent.
Capacity utilisation in manufacturing industry rose over one percentage point year-on-year in November to nearly 86 percent, SF said.
